caption_L1: This line diagram is named Number of Hollister retail stores worldwide from 2000 to 2019. The x-axis plots Year on linear scale from 2000 to 2015 while the y-axis plots Number of stores using linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 600.
caption_L2L3: the number of Hollister stores increased quite rapidly from inception in 2000 to around just over 500 stores stores in 2007, they rose to around 600 stores in 2013 before dropping back slightly to around 550 stores in 2019.
